import json,os
def transform(g):
    from collections import Counter
    c=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    # divider color: forms full rows/cols; find color whose full rows exist
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    div=None
    for col,n in c.items():
        if any(all(x==col for x in r) for r in g) and any(all(g[i][j]==col for j in range(W)) for i in range(H)):
            div=col;break
    div=div if div is not None else c.most_common()[-1][0]
    rest=[x for r in g for x in r if x!=div]
    common=Counter(rest).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rare=[k for k in Counter(rest) if k!=common]
    rare=rare[0] if rare else common
    rows=[i for i in range(H) if all(x==div for x in g[i])]
    cols=[j for j in range(W) if all(g[i][j]==div for i in range(H))]
    def groups(n,divs):
        gs=[];s=0
        for d in divs+[n]:
            if d>s: gs.append(list(range(s,d)))
            s=d+1
        return gs
    R=groups(H,rows);C=groups(W,cols)
    out=[]
    for rs in R:
        row=[]
        for cs in C:
            tile=[g[i][j] for i in rs for j in cs]
            row.append(1 if rare in tile else common)
        out.append(row)
    return out

            div=col;break
    rest=Counter(x for r in g for x in r if x!=div)
    common=rest.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rare=[k for k in rest if k!=common][0]
    rows=[i for i in range(H) if all(x==div for x in g[i])]
    cols=[j for j in range(W) if all(g[i][j]==div for i in range(H))]
    def groups(n,divs):
        gs=[];s=0

            s=d+1

    out=[]
    for rs in groups(H,rows):
        row=[]
        for cs in groups(W,cols):
            cnt=sum(1 for i in rs for j in cs if g[i][j]==rare)
            row.append(1 if cnt>=2 else common)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
